products.title: Garmin vivoactive 5 - Slate Aluminium Bezel with Black Case and Silicone Band
products.body_html:
Know the Real You with the Garmin vivoactive 5 – a purpose-built fitness smartwatch with advanced health and fitness features. Featuring a bright 1.2" AMOLED touchscreen display, up to 11 days of battery life, and 30+ built-in sports apps, this watch helps you stay on top of your health and fitness goals.

 

Key Features:

  • Bright 1.2" AMOLED touchscreen with optional always-on display mode
  • - Up to 11 days battery life in smartwatch mode (5 days display always-on)
  • - Body Battery™ Energy Monitoring to track your energy levels throughout the day
  • - Advanced sleep tracking with Sleep Score and Sleep Coach
  • - Wrist-based heart rate monitoring, Pulse Ox blood oxygen saturation (SpO2)
  • - 30+ preloaded sports apps including running, cycling, swimming, yoga, and more
  • - Built-in GPS with GLONASS and Galileo support
  • - Garmin Pay™ contactless payments
  • - Music storage – download from Spotify, Deezer or Amazon Music
  • - Water rating: 5 ATM / Swim-proof
  • - Safety & incident detection features
  • - Compatible with iPhone and Android smartphones
  • - Quick release 20mm bands (industry standard)
  • - Physical size: 42.2 x 42.2 x 11.1 mm | Weight: 26g (36g with band)
  • - Part Number: 010-02862-10
